context.title: False Alarm Reduction & Context Awareness
context.subtitle: Mitigating 'Alarm Fatigue' experienced by medical staff due to frequent false alarms by transitioning from raw thresholding to comprehensive patient context evaluation.
context.physiological_desc: Direct vital signs such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, and respiratory rate.
context.activity_desc: Tracking patient posture (lying, sitting, moving) to dynamically adjust risk thresholds based on physical exertion.
context.environment_desc: Monitoring environmental metrics impacting patient vitals, such as ambient room temperature.
context.custom_rules_desc: Overriding general baseline thresholds with personalized risk bounds derived from individual patient diagnostic records.

proactive.title: Proactive Monitoring & Early Prediction
proactive.subtitle: Evolving from a reactive alert framework into a proactive engine capable of identifying clinical deterioration prior to acute onset.
proactive.ai_model_desc: Embedding an AI model trained on validated global clinical datasets to discover hidden patterns of physiological decay and predict future risks.
proactive.safety_rules_desc: Time-bounded rules analyzing symptom duration and rate-of-change to guarantee clinical compliance and filter out transient vital spikes.

fog.title: Real-Time Processing & Fog Architecture
fog.subtitle: A distributed computing architecture ensuring sub-second local decision making near the patient, safeguarding continuity of care during cloud connectivity loss.
fog.pipeline_desc: A seamless pipeline routing data from medical sensors to the fog layer, then syncing with the cloud for long-term historical storage.
fog.mobile_node_title: Mobile Device as a Local Fog Node
fog.mobile_node_desc: Leveraging the mobile application as an edge processing node to ingest and evaluate sensor feeds locally without awaiting cloud responses, delivering immediate localized alerts anywhere, anytime.

roles.title: User Roles & Access Management
roles.subtitle: Structuring permissions and interfaces according to clinical and administrative duties to deliver precise actionable data:
roles.doctor_desc: Accessing complex cases, inspecting predictive analytics, and tailoring patient-specific rule profiles.
roles.caregiver_desc: Receiving rapid-response alerts and managing real-time alert states between active and resolved.
roles.patient_desc: A simplified, dedicated view displaying current vital signs and physical activity recommendations.
roles.admin_desc: Managing node architecture, pairing sensors/hardware, and monitoring global system telemetry.
